method: Renders r13 (head 72770eb, which includes the unrated w12 fixes in 0c2b6fb; 09d_suite.js is 361 lines) compared with omaat_f60, f7, f11 and f57 and the official f_17313. Measurements are PIL box means and column-luminance profiles, compared as ratios within one image. Crops are in scratchpad/qa13b/: q04_duvet.png, v4_beds.png, q02_right_leaves.png, q02_left_leaves.png, v5z.png, flank_f60_vs_v1.png, v1_plinth.png, s4_module.png, s2_ottoman.png and f11_ottoman.png. Lighting is noted but not scored.

calibration.earlier_issue: w11a/b MED: with the doors closed, a continuous plinth ran under the meeting leaves
calibration.status: still fixed. v1 void/field is 20/80 = 0.25, against 19/67 = 0.28 in f60. Plinth/field is 55/80 = 0.69, against 47/67 = 0.70.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a LOW / w12b LOW: the duvet fold reads as a decal or ruled line, and the corner logic was inverted
calibration.status: partly fixed. The logic is now right: bare sheet on the head-aisle corner (line 308) and the flap underside-up across the diagonal (line 309). The bright rod is gone, replaced by a broad roll in the duvet colour (line 310). The flap now has a tonal step: L212 against the duvet's 241 (0.88, which meets the w12a target of 0.92 or less). It still reads as an overlay, though. The 'bare sheet' is a plate lying on top of the duvet, and the duvet slab's rounded raised edges carry on square round the corner, so no corner is actually turned down. The flap is a flat grey triangle with hard straight edges, and at the v4 top angle it reads as translucent plastic. It is also too small: legs 0.30, where in f57 the diagonal runs almost the whole bed width (qa13b/q04_duvet.png, v4_beds.png).

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a/b LOW (w11 too): hard flat triangular wedge ends on the console module
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 173 is unchanged. See s4 x 520-545 and qa13b/s4_module.png (both ends), and v2.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a LOW: grip slots were square-ish holes at mid-plinth
calibration.status: fixed. Line 264 makes them 0.12 x 0.045 at y 0.115. In v1 they are about 24 x 7 px, high on the plinth (f60 is about 2.7:1). They are still cool blue-black, RGB (21, 23, 28) against f60's (19, 22, 13), because they use SEATMAT.black.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a/b LOW: stipple moire on the fluted leaves at grazing and distant angles
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 249 is unchanged. q02 x 830-900 still shows the chain pattern on the far right-hand leaves (qa13b/q02_right_leaves.png). The near leaves in v5 are clean (qa13b/v5z.png).

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a LOW: wood flanks too dark (flank/field 0.47)
calibration.status: fixed in luminance. v1 flank/field is 46.5/79.7 = 0.58, against 0.53-0.63 in f60. A hue problem shows now (see issues): RGB (62, 45, 32), R/G 1.37, against f60's (43, 40, 23)-(52, 46, 27), R/G 1.08-1.13.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a LOW: duvet head end is a uniform rounded step
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 304 is unchanged (edge 0.04, crown 0.012).

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a LOW: 1 px light vertical tick in the forward plinth face
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 262 nudged the plinth from hx + 0.002 to + 0.003, but the tick is still at v1 x 445, y 405-415 (qa13b/v1_plinth.png). It is also in s6 at the same place, so it does not depend on the door state.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12b LOW: the flute grooves are too light (0.74x the slat)
calibration.status: not changed, and I withdraw it. Over a like-for-like band, the v1 relief p90/p10 is 1.34, against 1.15 in f60 (f60 row: slats L76-86, grooves L63-69, about 0.8x). The render already has at least the photo's relief.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12b LOW: doorway proportion (closed void 0.61 of the leaf pair, against 0.40 in f60; open gap about 1.28 leaf widths, against 0.95 in f7)
calibration.status: not changed. The leaves are still 0.50 and the opening 0.64. v1 void x 262-414 sits under leaves x 214-465 (0.61). The question to the integrator stands.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12b LOW: cool blue-black doorway void
calibration.status: fixed. Line 241 sets #16130f. v1 void reads (23, 20, 16), against f60's (22, 21, 12).

calibration.earlier_issue: Out of scope (w12a/b): ottoman tweed, sun lozenges, plaques
calibration.status: Sun lozenges and plaques are unchanged (other owners). The ottoman was re-measured: its luminance is fine as a ratio (ottoman/aisle-box side is q03 1.51 and s2 1.35, against f11 1.85), and so is its hue (R-B 16-22, against f11 23). The difference is the weave: f11 is a salt-and-pepper tweed with strong micro-contrast, and the render is a flat beige felt (qa13b/s2_ottoman.png vs f11_ottoman.png). SEATMAT.fFabric is used only by the suite.

issues.issue: The turned-down duvet corner is still an overlay rather than a fold, and is too small. The 'bare sheet' triangle lies ON the duvet slab, whose raised rounded edges carry on square round the corner, so nothing is actually turned back. The flap is a flat hard-edged grey triangle; at the v4 top view it reads as translucent plastic. In f57 the fold diagonal runs from the window side near the lavender cushion to the aisle edge about 0.5-0.6 m toward the foot. The belt lies on bare sheet inside that triangle, and the duvet's head edge on the window side reaches nearly to the cushion. q04 is a key passenger view, and this is now its dominant suite artefact after the sun patches (lighting).
issues.evidence: qa13b/q04_duvet.png: the flap is L212 and the sheet plate L234, inside a duvet outline that continues round the corner (q04 rows y 330-390: the 249 rim at x 410-425 runs past the triangle). qa13b/v4_beds.png. omaat_f57: the bare sheet region spans most of the bed width.
issues.fix: Line 304: replace the duvet loft with a chamfered slab, so the corner really is missing: B.add(gExtrude([[xe - dw, -dz0], [xe - 0.50, -dz0], [xe, -dz0 + 0.50], [xe, -dz0 + dl], [xe - dw, -dz0 + dl]], 0.045), M4.trs(0, 0.535, 0, 0, -Math.PI / 2), duv), with dz0 = -0.74 and dl = 1.32 (line 303), so the window-side head edge reaches the cushion. Keep the soft edge with a gRBox(0.03, 0.03, len, 0.014, 2) roll along the window and foot edges if needed. Line 308: delete it, because the pad (line 297) now shows through as the bare sheet. Line 309: make the flap the mirror of the cut corner across the diagonal, legs 0.50: [[xe - 0.50, -dz0], [xe, -dz0 + 0.50], [xe - 0.50, -dz0 + 0.50]], at y 0.538, 0.008 thick, #b9b5ad. Line 310: lengthen the roll to 0.71 at M4.trs(xe - 0.25, 0.536, dz0 - 0.25, 135 * DEG). The belt at bz -0.80, 0.21 from the aisle edge, then lies inside the bare triangle (0.21 + 0.06 < 0.50), as in f57.

issues.issue: The wood flanks are chestnut red-brown with a short, noisy grain. In f60 they are an espresso / olive-brown with long, fine, horizontal streaks (macassar-like). They fill about 40 % of the closed aisle face (v1 / v2 / v5) and are visible all along the aisle in q02, so the hue difference reads at once.
issues.evidence: qa13b/flank_f60_vs_v1.png. v1 flank RGB (62, 45, 32), R/G 1.37. f60 flanks (43, 40, 23) and (52, 46, 27), R/G 1.08-1.13. For comparison, f7 wing wood is (54, 50, 46) and q03 wing wood (51, 42, 39), so the interior wood is closer.
issues.fix: Line 27: fFlank c '#33291f' -> '#2f2b22' (same luminance, R/G about 1.1). For the grain: give the flanks their own straight-grain swatch cut from omaat_f60 x 940-1170 (test/make_swatches.py -> tex/, with a dedicated LAYER), or stretch the fWood layer's streak length about 4x along z on the flank boxes (lines 266 and 354) through their UV scale. The wing and pier wood can keep the current layer.

issues.issue: Stipple / chain moire persists on the fluted leaves at cabin distance and grazing angles.
issues.evidence: qa13b/q02_right_leaves.png (q02 x 830-900, y 200-500), unchanged since w11. Near views (v1, v5) are clean.
issues.fix: Line 249: in the cabin build, either lower the slats' proud from 0.005 to 0.0025 (gBox(0.0025, ...) at x + 0.0032), or above a distance threshold swap the slat loop for one quad with a mip-mapped 0.026-period stripe. The far LOD at line 353 already uses a flat panel, so pulling the LOD switch nearer for the leaves alone also works. Ask the lighting owner about shadow bias on 5 mm steps.

issues.evidence: s4 x 520-545 and qa13b/s4_module.png (both ends); v2 x 130-240.

issues.fix: Superseded by the medium fix if the duvet becomes the chamfered slab. Otherwise, line 304: edge 0.04 -> 0.03, crown 0.012 -> 0.02.
